name: yacs
description: Learn, design, sweep, analyze, repair, and optimize superconducting microwave circuits in YACS.

interface.shortDescription: Design and analyze circuits in YACS.
interface.longDescription: Use focused YACS skills and the local MCP integration to learn from verified examples, choose and configure analyses, explore design sensitivity, construct topology-safe schematics, repair workspaces, and guide optimizations in the installed YACS Desktop app.
defaultPrompt: Take me from an idea to my first validated YACS result.
